why: The criterion holds. I checked every named item against the repository: bin/greet.js, src/greet.js, docs/index.md, .github/workflows/pages.yml, test/greet.test.js, `npm test` (package.json has "test": "node --test") and `greeting(name)`. All of them exist. The problem statement is accurate. bin/greet.js picks the first argument that doesn't start with '--' as the name and ignores the rest, so `--shout Ada` prints `Hello, Ada!`. With no name it writes a usage message to stderr and exits 2. src/greet.js exports only `greeting`, which returns `Hello, ${name}!`. docs/index.md shows only `node bin/greet.js <name>`. pages.yml publishes `docs` on every push to main. The test file has no shout test. The docs URL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ matches the README. The `--shout` option is new, which is what the issue asks for, so no claim describes something that isn't there.
